mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dms_tenant_config_version (tenant_id, version_no, change_type, tenant_snapshot, display_snapshot, operator_id, operator_name, source_version_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{versionNo}, #{changeType}, #{tenantSnapshot}, #{displaySnapshot}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{sourceVersionId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dms_tenant_config_version WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}

SELECT id, tenant_id, version_no, change_type, tenant_snapshot, display_snapshot, operator_id, operator_name, source_version_id, create_time FROM dms_tenant_config_version WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}

SELECT id, tenant_id AS tenantId, version_no AS versionNo, change_type AS changeType, operator_id AS operatorId, operator_name AS operatorName, source_version_id AS sourceVersionId, create_time AS createTime FROM dms_tenant_config_version WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY id DESC
